import numpy as np, torch, model
net = model.load(); neg = model.negatives()
print(type(neg), getattr(neg,'keys',lambda:None)())
uid=np.asarray(neg['uid']); c=np.asarray(neg['c']); xi=np.asarray(neg['xi']); a=np.asarray(neg['a'])
print(len(uid), uid[:20])
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
T=[]
for i in range(len(uid)):
    z=rng.standard_normal((2048,2)).astype(np.float32)
    acts=model.decode(net,z,np.full(2048,c[i],np.float32))
    acts=acts[0] if isinstance(acts,tuple) else acts
    acts=np.asarray(acts)
    ib=np.asarray(model.in_basin(i,acts)).astype(bool)
    d=np.linalg.norm(z-xi[i],axis=1); d[ib]=1e9
    j=np.argmin(d); T.append(acts[j])
    print(i,uid[i],round(float(c[i]),3),a[i].round(2),'share_in',ib.mean().round(3),'tgt',acts[j].round(2),'dz',round(float(d[j]),2))
np.save('T.npy',np.array(T,np.float32))
